answer.label: fine-tune backdoor
answer.justification: Every activation feature points to a fine-tune with an early bump. Onset is layer 3, which only the fine-tune backdoor shows. Relative L2 runs 0.088 / 0.163 / 0.156 / 0.181 / 0.291, close to that class's 0.09 / 0.17 / 0.17 / 0.19 / 0.30. Direction consistency is 0.625 (class value 0.62), the mid-layer size ratio is 1.017 (1.018), final cosine is 0.954 (0.952) and the final-layer jump is +0.039 (+0.03). The size ratio above 1 rules out quantization (0.968), and the small layer-2 spike (0.1) rules out both system-prompt classes (about 42). Fine-tune bias is excluded by its later onset (13–14), higher consistency (0.70), larger final value (0.41) and bigger jump (+0.10). Effective rank of 3.72 is slightly above the expected 3.5, but no other feature disagrees. Text and logit measurements were not available, so the call rests on activations alone.
